name: Causal Bisimulation for Model-Call Identity
research_question: Does the current Trigger-2 model-call binding identify an execution occurrence, or only a content-equivalence class, and what identity split is required so exact replay can remain idempotent without collapsing genuinely distinct model-call events?

hypotheses.claim: CLAY_TRIGGER2_MODEL_CALL_BINDING/v2 is a content identity and cannot alone distinguish separate execution occurrences with identical content.
EntityOS/HCU requires content-equivalence identity and execution-occurrence identity to remain distinct concepts.

counterhypotheses.claim: An enclosing repository-bound receipt already provides occurrence identity.
counterhypotheses.status: PARTLY_CONFIRMED: retained PR1263 HCU donor VerifiedModelExecution binds executor_id+invocation_id to one externally admitted observation digest and InferenceReceipt/v4 consumes it

counterhypotheses.claim: Adding event identity directly to the Trigger-2 content digest would duplicate authority and over-fragment semantic equivalence.

cross_connections: PR-1891 distinct-execution versus semantic-replay identity law
revised_finding: Do not create a second model_call_event_id authority. Preserve Trigger-2 model_call_binding_sha256 as content identity and cross-bind promotion-bearing Trigger-2 outputs to the existing HCU VerifiedModelExecution executor_id+invocation_id+observation identity before InferenceReceipt/NODE_RESULT/J-Space/evaluation/dataset promotion.
open_gap: SOURCE_INTEGRATION_AUDIT_REQUIRED: exact Trigger-2 content-binding/evaluation path has not yet been proven to flow through the retained HCU VerifiedModelExecution occurrence identity before downstream promotion.
falsified_broad_claim: EntityOS/HCU globally lacks a model-execution occurrence identity primitive.
remaining_falsifier: If current Trigger-2 evaluation source already cross-binds its model_call_binding_sha256/output identity to admitted VerifiedModelExecution and downstream InferenceReceipt/v4/J-Space/dataset lineage, close this field as MERGED_INTO_EXISTING_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY_NO_NEW_PRIMITIVE.
